evidence.quote: Submit application via Please apply via uni-assist.
International applicants without German high school diploma (applicants with international education background, but not for applicants as an exchange student / Erasmus)

value.quotedAs: proof of high school diploma certificate including transcripts in original language

evidence.quote: proof of high school diploma certificate including transcripts in original language, with proof of translation in German or English language

notes: For the tuition fact, the DAAD page only says 'Tuition fees per semester None', so amountMinor 0 is based on that quote. The intake deadline is stated without a year ('until 15 July'), so no ISO date was output. The applicationDeadline year is not given on the pages. The applicationChannel is reported as de-uni-assist based on the DAAD page's 'Please apply via uni-assist' and the university page listing 'International applicants without German high school diploma' among those who 'have to apply via uni-assist1'. No page explicitly uses the term VPD, so de-uni-assist-vpd was not chosen.

German language skills at A1 level (CEFR)

note.fr: Si votre diplôme étranger n'est pas équivalent au baccalauréat allemand, vous devez suivre une année préparatoire (Studienkolleg) et passer l'examen d'évaluation (Feststellungsprüfung).
note.en: If your foreign high school diploma is not equivalent to the German high school diploma, you must complete a preparatory course (Studienkolleg) and pass the assessment test (Feststellungsprüfung).

evidence.quote: If your foreign high school diploma is not equivalent to the German high school diploma, you must complete a preparatory course for university studies ("Studienkolleg") in Germany before beginning your studies, culminating in an assessment test ("Feststellungsprüfung – FSP").

note.fr: Des compétences en allemand au niveau A2 sont fortement recommandées.
note.en: German language skills at A2 level are strongly recommended.

evidence.quote: In addition, German language skills at A2 level (CEFR) are strongly recommended.
